tool_args.rationale: The earlier confirmation failed because predict referenced an unset module-level parameter vector. This corrected self-contained model numerically fits the four ODE parameters, reconstructs initial memory from each irregular raw prefix when mem_conv is absent, and uses RK4 for the specified forward integration.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight rows now satisfy the supplied minimum for the four-parameter memory ODE; an additional paid measurement is not needed before testing the model.
Endpoint-matched history differences and coupled transient lag are direct evidence for history-dependent coupled memory dynamics.
